Subject: Itinerary liaison & conferencing bridge contacts for Oct exec workshop

Hi Tom / Lakeshore team —

Thanks again for hosting our Oct 26–28 executive workshop. Attached is a working itinerary (initial_itinerary.xlsx) — the key asks from our side for planning: 

- Hotel room blocks (3 nights) for ~22 attendees and a small overflow (5 rooms)
- Shuttle routing: airport pick-up windows for Oct 26 (arrivals 09:00–15:00) and a late flight at 20:30
- Main meeting room preferred layout: horseshoe + two breakouts; cabling path on east wall
- Conferencing: we will run a hybrid session from 10:00–12:30 on Oct 27 (expected 30 remote participants). We need a vendor-managed SIP/Zoom bridge with redundant encoder/decoder and an on-site AV tech for the full day

Please confirm: point-of-contact for AV on site (name, mobile), lead for shuttle coordination, and whether you can provide a backup codec and a test window the day before. Also include any upcharges for extended tech hours and shuttle standby.

I'll consolidate and send the finalized itinerary to procurement for the hotel block and to security for the guest badge list once we have your confirmations.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of Partnerships Operations

Hi Rachel —

Appreciate the itinerary. Quick answers below: 

- Hotel blocks: we can hold 22 rooms + 5 overflow at Lakeshore Grand (walking distance, 3 mins). I will push the tentative block and send the DocuSign confirmation by EOD tomorrow.
- Shuttle: ShuttleCo (ops@shuttleco.com) handles airport transfers for us. They can cover the 09:00–15:00 window and standby for the 20:30 flight with a $90 flat fee for the last run (we will itemize). Contact: Maria Lopez, +1 212-555-4422.
- AV POC: On-site AV lead is Carlos Mendes, mobile +1 312-555-0099. He will bring a spare hardware H.264 encoder and an NEC backup codec. We budgeted 8 tech hours on Oct 27 (07:00–17:00) with a standard overtime rate if extended.
- Test window: We can do a 45-minute dry run on Oct 25, 15:00–15:45 at no charge. If you need an additional slot earlier, we can add it for $150.

I've CC'd venue_ops for logistics confirmation and ShuttleCo for pickup quotes. I will attach the AV rider and hotel block confirmations after I pull them from our system.

Best,
Tom Sato

Thanks Tom — helpful details. Couple of clarifications before we finalize: 

1) Backup connectivity: can Carlos provision a second upstream internet path (4G fallback or separate ISP) for the bridge? We need sub-100ms jitter target and a documented failover plan.
2) AV codecs: the remote team prefers an RTMP/Zoom-based ingest and a SIP fallback. Please confirm codec compatibility with our vendor bridge (we'll provide stream keys two weeks out).
3) Shuttle manifest: can ShuttleCo provide passenger ETA tracking (SMS/driver app) and a lead for on-site staging at arrivals? We need to coordinate wheelchair assistance for one guest and one oversized equipment crate.

We also need the on-site tech to be present for the lunch mic check on Oct 27 at 11:40 and to stay until 13:00 for a segmented break-out that will reconnect remote participants. If overtime applies, note it now so procurement can approve.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0321

Hi all —

Thanks for the follow-ups. Confirming items and next steps: 

- Internet/failover: Carlos confirmed a secondary cellular failover via a bonded 4G unit that will kick in automatically; he will provide a written failover SOP before the dry run.
- Codec/bridge compatibility: We will deliver both RTMP streams and a SIP trunk endpoint. Please send your Zoom/RTMP keys and the SIP URI by Oct 12.
- Shuttle manifest: Maria Lopez (ShuttleCo) will send a tracking link and an example manifest template by EOD tomorrow. They can accommodate one wheelchair and the oversized crate; driver will stage at Door 3.
- Tech hours & overtime: 8 tech hours are included; extended coverage to 13:00 will add one overtime hour at $120. Please flag in procurement if you want to include the extra hour in the PO.

Attached: AV_rider_final.pdf, hotel_block_confirm.pdf

We will be onsite Oct 25 (setup) and Oct 26–28 for the event. Carlos will be the POC on site (+1 312-555-0099). If you need me in person on Oct 27 I can also come by — happy to coordinate.

Best,
Tom
